description: A fixer: asks the runtime's own agent, once, for a fix of a program that failed, in the copy of the failing project it is handed, in the words trama itself has for it. Named as a run's repairWith.

parameters.program?: string: the program that failed, whole — handed by the runner to whoever is asked for a fix, as all of these are
parameters.journal?: string: the path of the failed run's record, a line of JSON for each call
parameters.kept?: boolean: whether what is changed beside the program, in the copy that is the workspace, is kept with the fix
parameters.types?: string: the API a program has, as its author is shown it

returns.unfixable?: string: why there is no fix, where the model says there is none
returns.nothing?: string: why nothing was fixed, where it was run with nothing to fix

input.prompt: A fixer of programs: asked for a fix where a run names this project as repairWith.
